name: Newborn Face Recognition Clinical Benchmark
description: A large-scale clinical dataset and evaluation suite assessing ResNet-based deep models for newborn face recognition.
reputation: A niche clinical benchmark used in biometric and medical research; adoption is limited due to sensitive data and domain constraints.
notes: Contains sensitive clinical data (newborn faces) with privacy and access restrictions; dataset is non-LLM, may be relatively small and domain-specific, and may have demographic/collection biases that affect generalization.
